description: This source file implements methods for the DataElement class and its derived class LinkedDataElement within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes CRC32 checksum calculation, buffer get/set methods, and a buffer copy method, referencing external buffer manipulation functions and data structures.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Class providing data buffer management and CRC32 checksum calculation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Derived class implementing linked buffer segments with methods for buffer access and copying.

methods.name: DataElement::CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified section of the data buffer.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a section of the buffer, handling optional cross-boundary reading via linked buffer segments.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets data in the buffer, handling cross-boundary writing into linked buffer segments.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another LinkedDataElement, handling multiple linked segments.
